answer: The sieve is Silver brass founder plate writ. It lets through the agent who paid a writ brass founders sign after foundry checks and catches everything else. The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 429 identities, 48906 POA, 6864 minutes. The trellis tells you who issued it, the river tells you what it cost, and the forge tells you when it was earned. Faking one identity is a project; faking a hundred is a bankruptcy.
